import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int MX = 200005;
    static final double PI = 4*Math.atan(1);

    static int R, C;
    static String S;

    static long comb[][] = new long[61][61];
    static long dp[][] = new long[31][31];

    static class Pair implements Comparable<Pair> {
        long first;
        long second;

        public Pair(long first, long second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }

        @Override
        public int compareTo(Pair o) {
            return Long.compare(first, o.first);
        }
    }

    static void dfsL(int ind, int a, int b, int mask, long p) {
        if (ind == C + 1) {
            dpL[a].add(new Pair(p, mask));
            return;
        }
        dfsL(ind + 1, a + 1, b, mask ^ (1 << ind), p + (comb[a + 1][R] - comb[a][R]) * (comb[R + C][R] - comb[b][R]));
        dfsL(ind + 1, a, b + 1, mask, p - (comb[b + 1][R] - comb[b][R]) * (comb[R + C][R] - comb[a][R]));
    }

    static void dfsR(int ind, int a, int b, int mask, long p) {
        if (ind == C + 1) {
            dpR[a].add(new Pair(p, mask));
            return;
        }
        dfsR(ind + 1, a - 1, b, mask ^ (1 << ind), p + (comb[a][R] - comb[a - 1][R]) * (comb[R + C][R] - comb[b][R]));
        dfsR(ind + 1, a, b - 1, mask, p - (comb[b][R] - comb[b - 1][R]) * (comb[R + C][R] - comb[a][R]));
    }

    static long ans = 0;

    static void check(long x, int t) {
        int a = 0, b = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < S.length() - (2 * C + 2); i++) {
            if (S.charAt(i) == 'A') a++;
            if (S.charAt(i) == 'B') b++;
        }
        for (int i = 2 * C + 2; i < S.length(); i++) {
            if (x % 2 == 1) {
                if (S.charAt(i) == 'B') return;
            } else {
                if (S.charAt(i) == 'A') return;
            }
            x /= 2;
            if (S.charAt(i) == 'A') a++;
            if (S.charAt(i) == 'B') b++;
        }
        long tmp = 0;
        if (x % 2 == 1) {
            tmp = comb[R - 1 - a + b][R - 1 - a];
        } else {
            tmp = comb[a + R - 1 - a + b][a + R - 1 - a];
        }
        ans += t * tmp;
    }

    static boolean ok(long x) {
        for (int i = 0; i < C + 1; i++) {
            if ((x & (1L << i)) == 1) {
                if (S.charAt(S.length() - C - 1 + i) == 'B') return false;
            } else {
                if (S.charAt(S.length() - C - 1 + i) == 'A') return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        R = sc.nextInt();
        C = sc.nextInt();
        S = sc.next();
        for (int i = 0; i <= 60; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= 60; j++) {
                comb[i][j] = 0;
            }
        }
        comb[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 60; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
                comb[i][j] = comb[i - 1][j];
                if (j > 0) comb[i][j] += comb[i - 1][j - 1];
            }
        }
        List<Pair>[] dpL = new List[R + C + 1];
        List<Pair>[] dpR = new List[R + C + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= R + C; i++) {
            dpL[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            dpR[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        dfsL(0, R - 1, R - 1, 0, 0);
        dfsR(0, R + C, R + C, 0, 0);
        long dif = Long.MAX_VALUE;
        for (int i = 0; i <= R + C; i++) {
            Collections.sort(dpL[i]);
            Collections.sort(dpR[i]);
            Collections.reverse(dpR[i]);
            int ind = 0;
            for (Pair t : dpL[i]) {
                while (ind + 1 < dpR[i].size() && t.first + dpR[i].get(ind + 1).first >= 0) ind++;
                dif = Math.min(dif, Math.abs(t.first + dpR[i].get(ind).first));
                if (ind + 1 < dpR[i].size()) dif = Math.min(dif, Math.abs(t.first + dpR[i].get(ind + 1).first));
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= R + C; i++) {
            List<Pair> z = new ArrayList<>();
            for (Pair t : dpR[i]) {
                if (ok(rev(t.second, C + 1))) z.add(t);
            }
            int ind = 0;
            int l = 0, r = -1;
            for (Pair t : dpL[i]) {
                while (l < z.size() && t.first + z.get(l).first > dif) l++;
                while (r + 1 < z.size() && t.first + z.get(r + 1).first >= -dif) r++;
                if (l <= r) {
                    check(t.second | (rev(z.get(l).second, C + 1) << (C + 1)), r - l + 1);
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    static long rev(long x, int y) {
        long z = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < y; i++) {
            if ((x & (1L << i)) == 1) z ^= 1L << (y - 1 - i);
        }
        return z;
    }

    static class Scanner {
        BufferedReader br;
        StringTokenizer st;

        public Scanner(InputStream s) {
            br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(s));
        }

        public Scanner(FileReader f) {
            br = new BufferedReader(f);
        }

        public String next() throws IOException {
            while (st == null || !st.hasMoreTokens())
                st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            return st.nextToken();
        }

        public int nextInt() throws IOException {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }

        public long nextLong() throws IOException {
            return Long.parseLong(next());
        }

        public String nextLine() throws IOException {
            return br.readLine();
        }

        public double nextDouble() throws IOException {
            String x = next();
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder("0");
            double res = 0, f = 1;
            boolean dec = false, neg = false;
            int start = 0;
            if (x.charAt(0) == '-') {
                neg = true;
                start++;
            }
            for (int i = start; i < sz(x); i++)
                if (x.charAt(i) == '.') {
                    res = Long.parseLong(sb.toString());
                    sb = new StringBuilder("0");
                    dec = true;
                } else {
                    sb.append(x.charAt(i));
                    if (dec)
                        f *= 10;
                }
            res += Long.parseLong(sb.toString()) / f;
            return res * (neg ? -1 : 1);
        }

        public long[] nextlongArray(int n) throws IOException {
            long[] a = new long[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
                a[i] = nextLong();
            return a;
        }

        public Long[] nextLongArray(int n) throws IOException {
            Long[] a = new Long[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
                a[i] = nextLong();
            return a;
        }

        public int[] nextIntArray(int n) throws IOException {
            int[] a = new int[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
                a[i] = nextInt();
            return a;
        }

        public Integer[] nextIntegerArray(int n) throws IOException {
            Integer[] a = new Integer[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
                a[i] = nextInt();
            return a;
        }

        public boolean ready() throws IOException {
            return br.ready();
        }
    }
}
